problem_context.problem_statement: Initialize an intrusive circular doubly linked-list sentinel.
problem_context.expected_behavior: Overwrite both owned sentinel link fields so an empty circular list is established.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Require a non-null sentinel and writable ownership of both link fields with anonymous old values; ensure xizi_dll(head@pre,nil).
spec_hint: Use store(field, _) for overwritten fields. Keep INPUT untouched. Reuse QCIPLib.xizi.xizi_double_link_common only.

annotation_design_summary.engineering_rationale: The initializer overwrites both fields, so caller-visible old values are irrelevant. A built-in opaque write-ownership predicate keeps the contract compositional and avoids existential plumbing.
annotation_design_summary.memory_precondition: non-null sentinel with value-opaque exclusive ownership of node_next and node_prev
